notes: Anchored corpus for PolyDiff image-family rediscovery + synthetic regressions.
Witnesses are pinned by SHA-256 ONLY. NO payload bytes appear in this repo.
The CVE-2023-4863 witness is vendored at reprochain/corpora-private/ engineering-private; the public/engineering image-family pipeline only handles the hash + size.
Synthetic anchors exercise the four canonical image divergence shapes from Asemarefactor.md lines 87-92: decode_outcome (HIGH), dimensions (MEDIUM), color_space (LOW), frame_count (MEDIUM-HIGH).
Per-case `implementations` lists the two wrapper ids the case is designed to disagree on; the diff engine runs ALL declared wrappers and picks up these axes (plus any others that surface).
Per-case `expected_fact_vector_diff` is keyed by axis name; each value is a 2-element array of the two impls' observations (matches the `implementations` ordering).

cases.summary: libwebp BuildHuffmanTable heap buffer overflow via malformed VP8L Huffman table. Reachable in Signal Android through Glide -> libwebp fallback.
cases.limitations: witness bytes are NOT in this repo; pinned-hash anchor only. The expected fact-vector diff documents the canonical disagreement shape — actual binary outputs depend on the pinned libwebp/libheif versions in the devcontainer.

cases.summary: Synthetic anchor: image with declared 65536x65536 dimensions exceeds 32-bit RGBA buffer allocation. libwebp accepts; libavif rejects with decode_error.
cases.limitations: synthetic case constructed to exercise the dimensions-divergence triage rule

cases.summary: Synthetic anchor: animated WebP with 3 frames declared but only 1 frame's data follows. libwebp reports frame_count=3 (declared); libheif reports frame_count=1 (parsed).
cases.limitations: synthetic case constructed to exercise the frame-count-divergence triage rule (libwebp class)

cases.summary: Synthetic anchor: image declares sRGB ICC profile in EXIF + Display P3 in metadata. libwebp reports sRGB; libavif reports Display P3. Pixel buffer identical.
cases.limitations: synthetic case constructed to exercise the color-space-with-same-pixels noise rule
